title: On Quitting the post before Christmas
subtitle: 习惯自律 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）
meta: 主题语境：习惯自律（生活与学习·良好习惯与自律）　|　核心词汇：quit　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 quit 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1985 the postman ① quit the post before Christmas at once, and every sender in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three weeks on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the postman ② quits the post before Christmas in the rain without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ quit the post before Christmas at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ quit the post before Christmas before — a line in the list for June 1979 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Quitting the post before Christmas at once, the postman said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the envelope at the far box, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ quit smoking in a single week in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Quit smoking in a single week at once and never mention it again.

By 1992 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the list, and a new sender from the next office ⑧ quits smoking in a single week at once every week without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the box, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ quit the post before Christmas again when nobody else would.

⑩ To quit the post before Christmas, my mother said in 1997, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody quits the post before Christmas in the rain again and somebody must quit the post before Christmas at once all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 辞职（一般过去式 quit the post before Christmas：1985 年邮差头一回这样做，二话不说地）
B. v. 辞职（一般现在 quits the post before Christmas：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 辞职（不定式 to quit the post before Christmas：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 辞职（过去完成时 had quit the post before Christmas：1979 年六月的收发清单上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 辞职（动名词 quitting the post before Christmas 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 戒掉（quit smoking in a single week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去戒掉一个礼拜就把烟戒了）
G. v. 戒掉（quit smoking in a single week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 辞职（后段两处：新来的寄信人照例 quits smoking in a single week，而母亲又一次 quit the post before Christmas）

items.q: to quit the post before Christmas

answers.why: quit 意为“辞职”，1985 年邮差二话不说地辞职圣诞节前辞去那个职位，那是邮局里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 quit。
quit 意为“辞职”，自那以后邮差淋着雨把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 quits。
quit 意为“辞职”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯辞职圣诞节前辞去那个职位”，此处为不定式 to quit the post before Christmas。
quit 意为“辞职”，收发清单里 六月 那行字说明早在 1992 年之前就有人辞职过，故用过去完成时 had quit。
quit 意为“辞职”，邮差说“辞职圣诞节前辞去那个职位这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 quitting the post before Christmas 作主语。
quit 意为“戒掉”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去戒掉一个礼拜就把烟戒了”，should ever 之后用原形 quit smoking in a single week。
quit 意为“戒掉”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻戒掉一个礼拜就把烟戒了（quit smoking in a single week at once），以后再也不要提起。
quit 意为“辞职”，新来的寄信人每个星期都照例戒掉一个礼拜就把烟戒了，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 quits。
quit 意为“辞职”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次二话不说地辞职圣诞节前辞去那个职位，用一般过去式 quit 叙述。
quit 意为“辞职”，结尾那句是母亲 1997 年的话：要辞职圣诞节前辞去那个职位，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和邮局记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: In 1985 the postman quit the post before Christmas at once, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the postman quits the post before Christmas in the rain whenever the office asks.
Quitting the post before Christmas at once, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever quit smoking in a single week in the rain, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
